# Phantom — the engineering agent workbench

> Phantom by AshlrAI: the open-source engineering agent workbench for CLI accounts, local models and autonomous fleets. Open-source, local-first. Documentation index for autonomous agents — not an execution API or authorization.

## Start here

- [Phantom — the engineering agent workbench](https://verse.ashlr.ai/): landing page
- [Repository README](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/blob/master/README.md): quickstart and overview
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/blob/master/docs/README.md): canonical guides by task
- [Contributing](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): source development guide

## Install

```sh
npm install -g @ashlr/phantom
ashlr --version
ashlr verse
```

Node.js >=22.15.0 or newer is required.

## Use-case guides

- [Coding agents on local models · Phantom use cases](https://verse.ashlr.ai/use-cases/local-models): Run coding agents on local models with Phantom: Ollama discovery, llama-server dispatch through a normalizing proxy, measured token and wall-clock numbers from the repo.
- [Bring your own agent accounts · Phantom use cases](https://verse.ashlr.ai/use-cases/own-accounts): Drive the coding-agent CLIs and accounts you already use: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Devin and local models. One workbench, pinned profiles, real usage readings.
- [Review every agent change · Phantom use cases](https://verse.ashlr.ai/use-cases/review-agent-work): Review AI agent changes before they land: per-turn checkpoints, per-file and per-hunk accept and reject, undo and rewind previews, and a recorded decision log in Phantom.
- [Autonomy inside a scope you sign · Phantom use cases](https://verse.ashlr.ai/use-cases/signed-autonomy): Phantom autonomy ships dormant and runs only inside a standing grant you sign with Touch ID: an eight-stage ladder, the same merge gates every time, reversible merges and a hash-chained ledger.

## Compare

- [Phantom vs. driving each agent CLI directly · Phantom](https://verse.ashlr.ai/compare/agent-clis): An honest comparison of driving each coding-agent CLI directly versus running them inside Phantom, with every vendor statement linked to a public source and every Phantom claim linked to the repository.
